groups.why: Checks the YesOrNo combo with no validYn in the request; that request differs from the other rows, so it stays alone.
Checks the YesOrNo combo with validYn='Y' in the request, which is a different request from the one without validYn, so it stays alone.
Checks the LookupCommon combo for lookupType TRANSPORT_MODE_CODE; the lookup type is unique, so it stays alone.
Checks LookupCommon for OPERATION_GROUP with no validYn, which differs from the request with validYn='Y'.
Checks LookupCommon for OPERATION_GROUP with validYn='Y'; the extra condition makes it a different request.
Checks LookupCommon with no lookupType and validYn='Y'; this parameter combination appears in no other row.
Checks only the Division_SCP combo request, which no other row uses.
Checks the SCM0001_GET_DIVISION combo; its comboId and SQL differ from Division_SCP, so they are not grouped.
Checks the ToSiteByDivision combo with divisionId='' (empty), so its condition differs from divisionId='81'.
Checks the ToSiteByDivision combo with divisionId='81', so its condition differs from the empty-value request.
Checks the FromSiteByDivision combo with divisionId='' (empty), so its condition differs from divisionId='81'.
Checks the FromSiteByDivision combo with divisionId='81', so its condition differs from the empty-value request.
Checks the screen behavior of the Division* search condition; this element and method (saving master data in the UI, then checking the change is reflected) differ from the DB re-execution rows.
Checks the screen behavior of the Valid search condition, a different element from the other search conditions.
Checks the screen behavior of the To Site search condition, a different element from the other search conditions.
Checks the screen behavior of the From Site search condition, a different element from the other search conditions.
Checks the screen behavior of the Operation Group search condition, a different element from the other search conditions.
Checks the screen behavior of the Trans Mode search condition, a different element from the other search conditions.
Checks whether the Team search condition rebinds right after a new team is saved and still includes it after reopening; no other row targets this element with this expectation.
Checks the display value of the Team (DEPT_ID) cell combo; it expects the team name to show, which differs from DMF0003's 'change reflected on re-query', so they are kept apart to be safe.
Checks that a Team (DEPT_ID) changed in SSPM is reflected on re-query with Div=82; the condition and expectation differ from the cell-combo display-value row.
Checks the search-condition combo for a new master such as Sales Site after a single save succeeds; it cannot be tied to a specific search condition with confidence, so it stays alone.
Checks that End Customer and Sold to Customer newly registered in LOOKUP appear in the grid combo; no other row targets these grid cell combos.
